meta.parties: Cornelis Appuhamy v. Kiri Banda Et Al

rules.statement: A document acknowledging a debt is not liable to stamp duty if it was not given with the dominant intent of supplying evidence of such debt.
rules.supporting_quote: "In Ambica Dat Vyas v. Nityanud Singh 1, Banerjee and Henderson JJ. held that the mere fact of a document being an acknowledgment of a debt within the meaning of section 19 of the Indian Limitation Act would not make it liable to a stamp duty under the corresponding provisions of the Indian Stamp Act, and that other conditions were required to be fulfilled one of which was that it should be intended to supply evidence of a debt."
